methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.

actual_scope: Can the production k492-owner-repair hpe_audit_and_transport.py used by changed-word / layer-end transport audits adopt the proved exact shared-denominator integer rows from research/hpe-audit-fast-seed93/ so that the shipped transport path is faster while every honest and fuzz outcome stays identical, without editing SELECTED-SOURCE-bound sw4 transport copies?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling leave-alone production rewrites and remaining proved opt-in adapters. Leave-alone objects through #2375 (frame-pair enumeration production and earlier production promotions) were skipped. Wiring into SELECTED-SOURCE-bound complex-sw4-frame8 hpe_audit_and_transport.py copies was rejected to keep the selected inventory untouched. Wronskode's merged #1137 opt-in adapter already proved ~2.53× on layer-end controls with identical receipts; production research/complex-k492-owner-repair/code/hpe_audit_and_transport.py still used Fraction-dict rows. This session wires that equivalent rewrite into the shipped k492 source, vendors pairwise baseline bytes, and retargets dependent live pins to the still-pairwise SELECTED-SOURCE sw4 transport.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: transport audit appears across cold/gauge construction tooling. A faster identical receipt does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production hpe_audit_and_transport.py integer-row change with frozen baseline, identical transport outcomes, corruption controls, pin discipline, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not invent kappa, reopen leave-alone objects, or edit SELECTED-SOURCE-bound sw4 transport copies.
evidence: PASS_HPE_TRANSPORT_INTEGER_PRODUCTION via research/hpe-transport-integer-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE; PASS_IDENTICAL_HPE_TRANSPORT_INTEGER_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via pinned-CPU benchmark.py --rounds 5 (median 6.452→2.816 s, 2.291×); dependent live pins retarget to complex-sw4-frame8/local/hpe_audit_and_transport.py.
